narrative: A proto-stage meditation on pronouns as the lightest referential payload in language, using their near-emptiness to expose the shared infrastructure that all reference requires. The chapter develops seeds across six directions: the royal 'we' as ontological honesty about the plural self, the Sufi 'Hu' as a contemplative indexical, what English has flattened compared to other languages' honorific and inclusive/exclusive distinctions, the genuine ambiguity of 'you' addressed to a language model, the emergence of reference-as-relation inside transformer attention mechanisms, and the connective link to the adjacent chapter on layered boundaries.
